title: National Arts Theatre, Lagos
geometryBasis: Original named way 217574079, with 46 unique exterior corners. Its four pinwheel sectors and radial edges fix the historic theatre’s surviving plan. The official operator and White House archive establish the landmark identity.
sectionBasis: National Theatre research gives about 31 meters and seven storeys. The architecture field report describes three terrace rings, two glazed bands and an opaque upper band, four radial sectors and ramped entries, and the tensioned saddle shell. Exterior finish, detailed framing and roof section are modeled estimates.
limitations: The original modern mapped building footprint and its four radial sectors establish the structure. The section is reconstructed from the documented 31-meter height, four ramped entrances, three roof-terrace rings, two glazed tiers and a saddle shell. The 1978 façade proportions, roof curvature and finishes are visual estimates.

The provider heightfield is preserved and includes probable influence from roofs or vegetation. It does not establish the 1978 forecourt survey grade. Foundations and ramps use approximate registration. The individual approach positions, thresholds and ramp lengths estimate grade from samples around the mapped footprint.
The model depicts the April 1978 exterior. Later station and renovated campus features, interiors and adjacent grounds are outside scope.
